lines.text: مصراع از براي تعیین ارباب مثلثات نهاري است اگر خواهي که ارباب مثلثات ليلي را بداني
lines.en: The hemistich is for determining the lords of the diurnal triplicities. If you want to know the lords of the nocturnal triplicities,

lines.text: حرف ربّ دوّیم که حرف سیّم کلمه است مقدم و او بر حرف ربّ اوّل که حرف دو کلمه است
lines.en: the letter of the second lord, which is the third letter of the word, precedes, and it is upon the letter of the first lord, which is the letter of two words.

lines.text: و بروج کرم همه مذکّر و نهاري اند و بروج سرد همه مؤنث و ليلي زيرا که طبيعت نهار حار
lines.en: And the warm signs are all masculine and diurnal, and the cold signs are all feminine and nocturnal, because the nature of the day is hot

lines.text: است و طبیعت لیل بارد و همچنین حرارت طبیعت مذکر زیاده است از حرارت طبیعت
lines.en: and the nature of the night is cold. And similarly, the heat of the masculine nature is greater than the heat of the feminine nature.

lines.text: مؤنث کما یثبت في موضعه ومخفي نماند که در تذکیر و تانیث بروج خلاف بسیار است چنانکه
lines.en: As is established in its place. And it should not remain hidden that there is much disagreement regarding the masculinity and femininity of the signs, such that

lines.text: بعضي از اوّل عقرب و اوّل جدي را خنثي خوانند لیکن انچه معتمد است آنست که مصنف
lines.en: some call the beginning of Scorpio and the beginning of Capricorn hermaphroditic, but what is reliable is what the author

lines.text: ذکر نموده است و جوزا و سنبله و میزان و دلو و نصف اوّل قوس انسي اند و باقي بروج
lines.en: has mentioned. And Gemini, Virgo, Libra, Aquarius, and the first half of Sagittarius are human, and the rest of the signs

lines.text: و نصف آخر قوس بهيمي با انکه قبل از اين در صور بروج بتفصيل مذکور شده است
lines.en: and the last half of Sagittarius are bestial, although this has been mentioned in detail previously regarding the forms of the signs.

lines.text: و میزان را با انکه صورت او از جمله جمادات است انسي گفتن بنا بر انست که الت قیاس
lines.en: And calling Libra human, even though its form is among the inanimate objects, is based on the fact that it is an instrument of measurement

lines.text: انست و بعضي او را بر صورت شخصي فرا گرفته اند که ترازوي بدست گرفته باشد پس چون
lines.en: for humans, and some have taken it to be in the form of a person holding a scale in their hand. So when

lines.text: مصنف از آن تعینات فارغ شد شروع نمود در تعیین بروج کواکب سبعه از بروج اثنی عشریه
lines.en: the author finished with those determinations, he began to determine the signs of the seven planets from the twelve signs.

lines.text: پس میفرماید که جدي و دلو خانهاي زحلند و قوس و حوت خانهاي مشتري اند و حمل
lines.en: So he says that Capricorn and Aquarius are the houses of Saturn, and Sagittarius and Pisces are the houses of Jupiter, and Aries

lines.text: و عقرب خانهاي مريخ اند و اسد خانه آفتاب و ثور و میزان خانهاي زهره جوزا و سنبله
lines.en: and Scorpio are the houses of Mars, and Leo is the house of the Sun, and Taurus and Libra are the houses of Venus, Gemini and Virgo

lines.text: خانهاي عطارد و سرطان خانه قمر و بناي این تقسیم بر آنست که گویند افتاب که نیّر
lines.en: are the houses of Mercury, and Cancer is the house of the Moon. And the basis of this division is that they say the Sun, which is the greater luminary,

lines.text: اعظم است و خسرو سیارات و ثوابت و مستقیم الاحوال و بطبع کرم و خشک پس جائیکه
lines.en: and the king of the planets and fixed stars, and is straightforward in its states, and is hot and dry by nature, so the place that

lines.text: کمال مناسب احوال او باشد هر ائینه اسد بود چه اسد بر هئیت بر صورت پادشاه جانوران و بطبع
lines.en: is perfectly suitable for its states is undoubtedly Leo, because Leo is in the form of the king of animals and by nature

lines.text: کرم و خشک و ثابت و موافق مزاج و خلق افتاب و غایت ارتفاع او ارفع از اکثر
lines.en: hot and dry and fixed, and agrees with the temperament and character of the Sun, and its maximum elevation is higher than most

lines.text: بروج در معظم معموره بعد از انماه که نیرا صغر است خلیفه و نظیر و عدیل افتابست
lines.en: signs in most of the inhabited world. After that, the Moon, which is the lesser luminary, is the deputy, peer, and equal of the Sun,

lines.en: and is swift in motion and variable in its states, and is cold and moist by nature, so the sign that is suitable for its states is undoubtedly

summary.headline: Triplicities and Planetary Houses
summary.text: Discussion of diurnal and nocturnal triplicity lords, the masculine, feminine, human, and bestial classifications of the signs, and the planetary houses: Saturn in Capricorn and Aquarius, Jupiter in Sagittarius and Pisces, Mars in Aries and Scorpio, the Sun in Leo, Venus in Taurus and Libra, Mercury in Gemini and Virgo, and the Moon in Cancer. The rationale for Leo as the Sun’s house and the Moon’s contrasting nature begins.
